dialogues.jp: ｛まぶた／瞼｝の外に光を感じる……もうだいぶ朝だな。
dialogues.en:
I felt light shining on my eyelids...... it must be morning
already.
dialogues.text:
I felt light shining on my eyelids...... it must be morning
already.

dialogues.jp:
朝、目覚めたときの布団の魔力――。なぜか、
ずっとこのままでいたい気分になってしまう。
それがまた心地よいのだが。
dialogues.en:
The bed feels warmer than normal, it makes me want to stay
in bed longer.
dialogues.text:
The bed feels warmer than normal, it makes me want to stay
in bed longer.

dialogues.jp:
どんづまりの叫び声に目を開けると、音夢が口
をあんぐりと開けて立ち尽くしていた。
dialogues.en:
I opened my eyes at the sound of Nemu screaming, and saw her
standing there with her mouth open in surprise.
dialogues.text:
I opened my eyes at the sound of Nemu screaming, and saw her
standing there with her mouth open in surprise.

dialogues.jp:
俺と音夢の間を｛さえぎ／遮｝るように、目の前でなにかが
起き上がる。
dialogues.en: Something rose in between me and Nemu.
dialogues.text: Something rose in between me and Nemu.

dialogues.jp: パジャマ姿のさくらが、布団の上で微笑む。
dialogues.en: Sakura in her pajamas was smiling on my bed.
dialogues.text: Sakura in her pajamas was smiling on my bed.

dialogues.jp: 空気の張り詰めた室内に場違いな声が響く。
dialogues.en: Her loud voice echoed in the tense atmosphere in my room.
dialogues.text: Her loud voice echoed in the tense atmosphere in my room.

dialogues.jp:
笑顔でさくらに応える音夢に、背筋が凍るもの
を感じる。
dialogues.en:
I felt a shiver run down my spine when I saw Nemu replying
to Sakura with a smile.
dialogues.text:
I felt a shiver run down my spine when I saw Nemu replying
to Sakura with a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、なんと申し上げましょうか……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'm afraid I'm not sure how to explain......"
dialogues.text: "Well, I'm afraid I'm not sure how to explain......"

dialogues.jp: 横からさくらが死の宣告を唱える。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんの……なんのスキンシップをしてるんで
　すか！」
dialogues.en: "What kind of...... intimacy are you two developing?!"
dialogues.text: "What kind of...... intimacy are you two developing?!"

dialogues.jp: 国語辞典が顔に炸裂し、後ろに倒れこむ。
dialogues.en: The encyclopedia landed on my face, and I fell backwards.
dialogues.text: The encyclopedia landed on my face, and I fell backwards.

dialogues.jp:
扉が閉まる音がして、部屋から負のオーラを放
つ存在が消える。
dialogues.en: The door closed, and the negative aura disappeared.
dialogues.text: The door closed, and the negative aura disappeared.

dialogues.jp:
さくらが顔を覗き込む気配をかすかに感じなが
ら、意識が遠のくのを感じる。
dialogues.en:
I was losing consciousness while feeling Sakura looking into
my face.
dialogues.text:
I was losing consciousness while feeling Sakura looking into
my face.

dialogues.en: The name of the victim, Junichi Asakura......
dialogues.text: The name of the victim, Junichi Asakura......

dialogues.jp:
どんづまりの叫び声に目が開けると、音夢が口
をあんぐりと開けて立ち尽くしていた。
dialogues.en:
I opened my eyes at the sound of Nemu screaming, and saw her
standing there with her mouth open in surprise.
dialogues.text:
I opened my eyes at the sound of Nemu screaming, and saw her
standing there with her mouth open in surprise.

dialogues.jp:
何だ──なんて首を傾げていると、さくらが目
の前に現れた。……俺のベッドから。
dialogues.en:
I was wondering -- what's going on, and then Sakura showed
up. ......From my bed.
dialogues.text:
I was wondering -- what's going on, and then Sakura showed
up. ......From my bed.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が放った国語辞典が顔に炸裂し、俺は意識
を失ったのだった……。
dialogues.en:
I lost consciousness when the encyclopedia that Nemu threw
caught me full in the face......
dialogues.text:
I lost consciousness when the encyclopedia that Nemu threw
caught me full in the face......
